"""串行跑 CellBender，一个一个来，每个跑完验证产出。跳过已完成的。"""
import subprocess, sys, os, time, glob

H5AD_DIR = r"F:\CellBender_v2"
OUT_BASE = r"F:\CellBender_v2\cellbender_output"
CELLBENDER = r"C:\Users\23136\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python312\Scripts\cellbender.exe"

def get_todo():
    h5ad_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(H5AD_DIR, "*.h5ad")))
    todo = []
    for f in h5ad_files:
        name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(f))[0]
        out_dir = os.path.join(OUT_BASE, name)
        filtered = os.path.join(out_dir, "cellbender_output_filtered.h5")
        if os.path.exists(filtered) and os.path.getsize(filtered) > 10 * 1024 * 1024:
            print(f"  [SKIP] {name} — filtered.h5 exists ({os.path.getsize(filtered)//1024//1024} MB)")
            continue
        todo.append((name, f, out_dir))
    return todo

def run_one(name, h5ad_path, out_dir):
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    log_file = os.path.join(out_dir, "cellbender_run.log")
    print(f"  [{idx+1}/{total}] {name} — starting...", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    cmd = [
        CELLBENDER, "remove-background",
        "--input", h5ad_path,
        "--output", out_dir,
        "--cuda",
        "--expected-cells", "5000",
        "--total-droplets", "25000",
        "--epochs", "150",
        "--low-count-threshold", "5",
        "--fpr", "0.01",
        "--learning-rate", "0.0001"
    ]
    with open(log_file, "w") as lf:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    elapsed = (time.time() - t0) / 60
    filtered = os.path.join(out_dir, "cellbender_output_filtered.h5")
    if proc.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(filtered):
        sz = os.path.getsize(filtered) // 1024 // 1024
        print(f"  [{idx+1}/{total}] {name} ✅ {sz} MB ({elapsed:.0f} min)", flush=True)
        return True
    else:
        print(f"  [{idx+1}/{total}] {name} ❌ rc={proc.returncode} ({elapsed:.0f} min)", flush=True)
        return False

todo = get_todo()
total = len(todo)
print(f"\n=== CellBender Serial Pipeline ===")
print(f"Total to run: {total}")
print(f"Output dir: {OUT_BASE}\n", flush=True)

ok = 0
fail = 0
for idx, (name, h5ad_path, out_dir) in enumerate(todo):
    if run_one(name, h5ad_path, out_dir):
        ok += 1
    else:
        fail += 1

print(f"\n=== DONE ===")
print(f"OK: {ok}, FAIL: {fail}")
